    for i, pi in enumerate(p):
        if bigger[pi] == 0:
            current_bigger += 1
        bigger[pi] = current_bigger

    for i in range(n):
        prefix_sum[i] = prefix_sum[i-1] + (1 if bigger[p[i]] == i else count[i-1] - count[bigger[p[i]]])
